notes: skillc#280: the local CI/CD capability profile for one Python project, at the same claude-power-pack pin (86641e8) as cpp-codex-flow-check-86641e8 and sharing its offline PyPI runtime (pydantic, pyyaml from the same pyproject/uv.lock). A SEPARATE profile with its own inventory; the flow-check profile, its evidence and every receipt bound to it are untouched. It selects the six cicd skills CPP's project:init and cicd:init flows rely on for one Python project (init, check, health, smoke, verify, pipeline); cicd-container, cicd-woodpecker and the infra-* skills need Docker, a Woodpecker server or a cloud account and are out of this profile's scope. No gate_entrypoint: these skills run lib.cicd directly, so runtime selection is the separate cicd-runtime (skillc/runtime_supply.py selected_runtime), an image that adds exactly one curl layer to the validated flow-check profile-runtime image (docker/cicd-trial/). Local semantics are PROFILE.md's: loopback HTTP only, provider pipelines are generated text (never executed here), CPP_OFFLINE=1. The project fixture's .claude/cicd.yml uses lib/cicd/config.py's real schema, not templates/cicd.yml.example's (claude-power-pack#1476). startup-context and helper are declared empty: CPP's Codex installer writes only skill directories at this pin, and the cicd skills call no installed helper script.
